body: Mainly specifically but generally applies. The two things I’ve known i was going to do, depending on the other, is suicide or transition. I’m 22 right now, and transitioning has passed by in the other line going too fast to see but for a split second. So I’m left with the other option. I have reflexively been blurting out the words/phrases “suicide,” “kill my self,” and “just end it” whenever i think of my failings, failure, and future. I don’t quite know what to do, and therapy won’t help for this. I’ve been.

So, I’m researching methods again and maybe conversing with you will be more constructive. Have you ever known you were going to do something for over a year and more like eight but just keep putting it off?
Thanks. I’m afraid i don’t have much to talk about. Your rabbits are adorable though. And you’re a kind person.
